items.headline: Rescued bonded labourers must get aid within a week
items.text: The Supreme Court said rescued bonded labourers should ordinarily get Rs 20,000 immediate aid within seven days of their release certificate, and that pending criminal cases are no reason to withhold it.
items.slide: Supreme Court deadline for rescued bonded labourers' aid

items.headline: Pulwama man's 15-month detention quashed
items.text: The J&K High Court quashed the Public Safety Act detention of a Pulwama man held since July 2025, saying alleged use of an encrypted app was no adequate basis for detention.
items.slide: J&K High Court quashes a Pulwama man's PSA detention

photo.alt: A narrow alley between tall brick houses with wooden windows and tangled wires overhead; a woman in a headscarf stands in the shade.
photo.caption: An alley in Srinagar's old city in 2016. The Public Safety Act is the main preventive detention law in Jammu and Kashmir.

items.headline: High Court takes up killings of lawyers
items.text: Karnataka's High Court opened a public-interest case on violence against lawyers, including two murders in October, and asked the state how it handles lawyers' complaints against police.
items.slide: Karnataka High Court opens a case on lawyers' killings

photo.alt: A large red colonnaded building with a triangular pediment behind a fence and gardens.
photo.caption: The High Court of Karnataka in Bengaluru (Attara Kacheri), in 2019.

items.figcap: to suspension and a murder case
items.headline: Officer who fired on villagers suspended, murder case filed
items.text: Bihar police suspended an officer who fired on villagers in Madhubani, killing one, and registered a murder case the same day. He has not been arrested.
items.slide: Bihar officer who fired on villagers faces a murder case

photo.alt: A railway platform whose walls are covered in colourful Mithila paintings, with red chairs and a few people.
photo.caption: Madhubani railway station, Bihar, decorated with Mithila paintings, in 2021.

items.headline: Court orders release of man held after bail
items.slide: Supreme Court orders release of a man jailed after bail
items.text: The Supreme Court ordered the immediate release of a man held weeks after it granted bail, and asked Uttar Pradesh why he should not be compensated. The state has until 3 December to reply.

photo.alt: A domed red and cream building with an Indian flag, behind trees and a black statue on a pedestal.
photo.caption: The Supreme Court of India in New Delhi.

items.headline: Case over a misspoken slogan quashed
items.slide: Karnataka court quashes case over a 2022 rally slogan
items.text: Karnataka's High Court quashed a case over a slogan shouted at a 2022 Mandya rally, saying continuing it would abuse the legal process and no unrest was shown.

photo.alt: A large red colonnaded building with a triangular pediment behind a fence and gardens.
photo.caption: The High Court of Karnataka in Bengaluru (Attara Kacheri), in 2019.
